title: Agentic In-Context Learning: What Algorithms Can Transformers Learn in Closed-Loop Interaction?
title_zh: 智能体式上下文学习：Transformer 能在闭环交互中学到什么算法？

paragraphs.en: The learning algorithm view of in-context learning (ICL) studies how fixed-parameter Transformers learn from supplied examples. Language model agents extend this setting through interaction: their actions determine what evidence enters context next. We call this regime Agentic In-Context Learning (Agentic ICL). Existing studies largely depend on externally supplied contexts or reward-bearing interaction histories, while work on general tool-using agents lacks a learning algorithm view. We represent an interactive learner by its state, update, and decision rule, covering active learning, bandits, and online reinforcement learning (RL). For expressivity, we construct causal Transformers that approximate these algorithms over a finite horizon, and bound the resulting loss in return. For training, we characterize when optimizing process rewards preserves behavior that maximizes the final outcome. Distillation experiments show that Transformers can learn to execute three representative recursions. We then train models from outcome or process rewards without oracle action or state targets, as in RL post-training. Different rewards yield distinct decision policies. Improving the alignment of process supervision with outcome-optimal action preferences shifts learned decisions accordingly. Such behavioral differences persist in a pretrained language model across textual paraphrases.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习（ICL）的学习算法视角研究固定参数的Transformer如何从所提供的示例中学习。 语言模型智能体通过交互扩展了这一设定：它们的动作决定了哪些证据接下来进入上下文。 我们将这种模式称为智能体上下文学习（Agentic ICL）。 现有研究在很大程度上依赖于外部提供的上下文或带有奖励信号的交互历史，而关于通用工具使用智能体的工作则缺乏学习算法视角。 我们用状态、更新和决策规则来表示一个交互式学习者，涵盖主动学习、老虎机问题和在线强化学习（RL）。 在表达能力方面，我们构造了在有限时域内近似这些算法的因果Transformer，并对由此产生的回报损失给出上界。 在训练方面，我们刻画了何时优化过程奖励能够保持最大化最终结果的行为。 蒸馏实验表明，Transformer能够学会执行三种具有代表性的递归。 随后，我们在没有示范动作或状态目标的情况下，从结果奖励或过程奖励训练模型，如同强化学习后训练一样。 不同的奖励会产生不同的决策策略。 改善过程监督与结果最优动作偏好之间的对齐，会相应地改变学到的决策。 这种行为差异在一个预训练语言模型中跨文本改写依然存在。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning (ICL) is a central way in which language models adapt at inference time: information in the prompt changes subsequent predictions while the model parameters remain fixed. This has motivated a learning algorithm view of ICL, which asks what estimator, update rule, or other learning computation a Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) implements through its forward passes over an externally supplied prompt ( Xie et al., 2022 ; Garg et al., 2022 ; Akyürek et al., 2023 ; von Oswald et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习（ICL）是语言模型在推理时进行适应的核心方式：提示中的信息会改变模型后续的预测，而模型参数保持不变。 这促成了一种将 ICL 视为学习算法的观点，该观点探究 Transformer（Vaswani et al., 2017）在对外部提供的提示进行前向传播时究竟实现了什么样的估计器、更新规则或其他学习计算（Xie et al., 2022；Garg et al., 2022；Akyürek et al., 2023；von Oswald et al., 2023；Bai et al., 2023；Wu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Modern language-model agents routinely operate in an analogous but closed-loop regime. An agent can browse the web, call tools, edit code, or run experiments, then use the returned results to choose later actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Lutz et al., 2024 ) . A search query determines which page is read, a code edit determines the next test result, and an experiment determines the next measurement. The agent therefore does not merely learn from a supplied context: through its actions, it helps determine the context from which it will learn next.
paragraphs.zh: 现代语言模型智能体通常会以一种类似但闭环的方式运行。 智能体可以浏览网页、调用工具、编辑代码或运行实验，然后利用返回的结果来选择后续的动作（Yao et al., 2023; Shinn et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2024; Lutz et al., 2024）。 一次搜索查询决定了接下来读取哪个页面，一次代码编辑决定了下一次的测试结果，一次实验决定了下一次的测量。 因此，智能体不仅仅是从一个给定的上下文中学习：它还通过自身的动作，参与决定了它接下来将从中学习的上下文。

paragraphs.en: We call this execution regime Agentic In-Context Learning (Agentic ICL). Starting from an initial prompt or task description, a fixed-parameter model chooses an action, receives feedback, and incorporates that feedback into its next decision. Its context grows through interaction with the environment. The returned feedback can be a search result, compiler error, measurement, critique, or reward. This motivates extending the learning algorithm view of ICL to interactive computations in which decisions shape subsequent evidence. The central question is:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这种执行机制称为智能体上下文学习（Agentic ICL）。 从初始提示或任务描述开始，一个参数固定的模型选择一个动作，接收反馈，并将该反馈纳入下一次决策。 它的上下文通过与环境的交互而增长。 返回的反馈可以是搜索结果、编译错误、测量值、批评意见或奖励。 这促使我们将上下文学习的学习算法视角扩展到交互式计算，其中决策会塑造后续证据。核心问题是：

paragraphs.en: What interactive algorithms can Transformers learn in context, and how do training objectives shape their behavior?
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 能在上下文中学习哪些交互式算法，训练目标又如何塑造它们的行为？

paragraphs.en: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) provides the closest precedent ( Laskin et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Liang and Lai, 2026 ) , but requires scalar rewards to be included in the interaction history. However, an agent usually receives non-reward feedback: a search result, compiler diagnostic, or measurement can guide the next action. We therefore develop Agentic ICL allowing agents to learn from non-reward feedback. This also separates the evidence used for in-context adaptation from the objective used for training and evaluation. Agentic ICL includes ICRL as a special case. Figure 1 illustrates this relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文内强化学习（ICRL）提供了最接近的先例（Laskin et al., 2023；Lee et al., 2023；Lin et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Liang and Lai, 2026），但它要求标量奖励包含在交互历史中。 然而，智能体通常接收到的是非奖励反馈：搜索结果、编译器诊断信息或测量数据都可以引导下一步动作。 因此，我们提出了 Agentic ICL，使智能体能够从非奖励反馈中学习。 这也将用于上下文内适应的证据与用于训练和评估的目标分离开来。 Agentic ICL 将 ICRL 作为其特例包含在内。 图 1 展示了这种关系。

sents.zh: 我们的贡献有四个方面：

paragraphs.en: What training learns (Section 6 ). Supervised distillation tests learned execution of supplied interactive recursions. RL without oracle action shows how outcome and process rewards lead to different decisions, and how those decisions change with controllable reward intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 训练学到什么（第 6 节）。 有监督蒸馏测试了习得的执行所提供的交互式递归的能力。 没有先知动作的强化学习展示了结果奖励与过程奖励如何导向不同的决策，以及这些决策如何随可控的奖励干预而改变。

sents.zh: 没有先知动作的强化学习展示了结果奖励与过程奖励如何导向不同的决策，以及这些决策如何随可控的奖励干预而改变。

paragraphs.en: ICL has been characterized as implicit Bayesian inference, regression, gradient descent, algorithm selection, and data-dependent learning-to-learn ( Xie et al., 2022 ; Garg et al., 2022 ; Akyürek et al., 2023 ; von Oswald et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Constructive, behavioral, and mechanistic studies identify familiar estimators inside Transformers ( Akyürek et al., 2023 ; von Oswald et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2023 ) ; we extend this standard to closed-loop recursions whose decisions determine subsequent in-context data. ICRL extends this perspective to RL updates and control, including pretraining on stored state-action-reward trajectories with source-policy or oracle actions ( Laskin et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . These models can nevertheless generate their own interaction histories at deployment. Prior work implements posterior sampling, bandit, TD, SARSA, or policy-improvement computations and distinguishes model-free from model-based strategies ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Fang and Rajan, 2025 ; Liang and Lai, 2026 ) . Our interface permits both reward-hidden and history-dependent feedback. Rewards used for training and evaluation need not be revealed in the agent’s transcript, and individual returned records need not be Markov states: the feedback law may depend on the full interaction history, from which the learner constructs its sufficient state. Agentic ICL unifies active learning, bandits, online RL, and tool use. The primary discovery experiments provide neither oracle actions nor sufficient-state targets.
paragraphs.zh: ICL 已被刻画为隐式贝叶斯推断、回归、梯度下降、算法选择以及依赖数据的学习如何学习（Xie 等，2022；Garg 等，2022；Akyürek 等，2023；von Oswald 等，2023；Bai 等，2023；Wu 等，2025）。 构造性、行为性和机制性的研究在 Transformer 中识别出熟悉的估计器（Akyürek 等，2023；von Oswald 等，2023；Bai 等，2023）；我们将这一标准扩展到闭环递归，其决策决定了后续的上下文内数据。 ICRL 将这一视角扩展到强化学习更新与控制，包括在存储的状态-动作-奖励轨迹上利用源策略或专家动作进行预训练（Laskin 等，2023；Lee 等，2023；Lin 等，2024）。 尽管如此，这些模型在部署时能够生成它们自己的交互历史。 已有工作实现了后验采样、多臂老虎机、TD、SARSA 或策略改进的计算，并区分了无模型与基于模型的策略（Wang 等，2025；Fang 和 Rajan，2025；Liang 和 Lai，2026）。 我们的接口同时允许隐藏奖励和依赖历史的反馈。 用于训练和评估的奖励无需在智能体的对话记录中揭示，且单条返回记录也无需是马尔可夫状态：反馈规律可以依赖于完整的交互历史，学习者从中构造其充分状态。 智能体式 ICL 统一了主动学习、多臂老虎机、在线强化学习和工具使用。 主要的发现类实验既不提供专家动作，也不提供充分状态目标。

sents.zh: ICL 已被刻画为隐式贝叶斯推断、回归、梯度下降、算法选择以及依赖数据的学习如何学习（Xie 等，2022；Garg 等，2022；Akyürek 等，2023；von Oswald 等，2023；Bai 等，2023；Wu 等，2025）。

sents.en: Constructive, behavioral, and mechanistic studies identify familiar estimators inside Transformers ( Akyürek et al., 2023 ; von Oswald et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2023 ) ; we extend this standard to closed-loop recursions whose decisions determine subsequent in-context data.
sents.zh: 构造性、行为性和机制性的研究在 Transformer 中识别出熟悉的估计器（Akyürek 等，2023；von Oswald 等，2023；Bai 等，2023）；我们将这一标准扩展到闭环递归，其决策决定了后续的上下文内数据。

sents.en: ICRL extends this perspective to RL updates and control, including pretraining on stored state-action-reward trajectories with source-policy or oracle actions ( Laskin et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: ICRL 将这一视角扩展到强化学习更新与控制，包括在存储的状态-动作-奖励轨迹上利用源策略或专家动作进行预训练（Laskin 等，2023；Lee 等，2023；Lin 等，2024）。

sents.en: These models can nevertheless generate their own interaction histories at deployment.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，这些模型在部署时能够生成它们自己的交互历史。

sents.en: Prior work implements posterior sampling, bandit, TD, SARSA, or policy-improvement computations and distinguishes model-free from model-based strategies ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Fang and Rajan, 2025 ; Liang and Lai, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 已有工作实现了后验采样、多臂老虎机、TD、SARSA 或策略改进的计算，并区分了无模型与基于模型的策略（Wang 等，2025；Fang 和 Rajan，2025；Liang 和 Lai，2026）。

sents.en: Our interface permits both reward-hidden and history-dependent feedback.
sents.zh: 我们的接口同时允许隐藏奖励和依赖历史的反馈。

sents.en: Rewards used for training and evaluation need not be revealed in the agent’s transcript, and individual returned records need not be Markov states: the feedback law may depend on the full interaction history, from which the learner constructs its sufficient state.
sents.zh: 用于训练和评估的奖励无需在智能体的对话记录中揭示，且单条返回记录也无需是马尔可夫状态：反馈规律可以依赖于完整的交互历史，学习者从中构造其充分状态。

sents.en: Agentic ICL unifies active learning, bandits, online RL, and tool use.
sents.zh: 智能体式 ICL 统一了主动学习、多臂老虎机、在线强化学习和工具使用。

sents.en: The primary discovery experiments provide neither oracle actions nor sufficient-state targets.
sents.zh: 主要的发现类实验既不提供专家动作，也不提供充分状态目标。

paragraphs.en: Tool agents append search results, test outputs, or other feedback to the context ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Lutz et al., 2024 ) , but are usually evaluated by success or transfer. Work on language feedback instead studies when language feedback is informative enough to enable efficient online learning ( Xu et al., 2026 ) or how to incorporate teacher-selected critique ( Klissarov et al., 2026 ) . We treat language as one possible returned record and compare candidate descriptions of the model’s state, update rule, and decision rule, separating compilation from behavior learned with terminal outcome reward. “Agentic in-context learning” has also named a stance-aggregation method ( Lee et al., 2025 ) ; we use the term for the interaction regime in Definition 3.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 工具智能体将搜索结果、测试输出或其他反馈附加到上下文中（Yao et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2024；Lutz et al., 2024），但通常仅以成功与否或迁移能力来评估它们。 关于语言反馈的研究则关注语言反馈何时具有足够的信息量以支持高效的在线学习（Xu et al., 2026），或如何融入教师选择的批评意见（Klissarov et al., 2026）。 我们将语言视为一种可能的返回记录，并对模型状态、更新规则和决策规则的候选描述进行比较，将编译过程与仅凭最终结果奖励学到的行为区分开来。“智能体式上下文学习”一词也曾用来指称一种立场聚合方法（Lee et al., 2025）；我们在定义 3.1 中用该术语指代交互机制。

paragraphs.en: We focus on learning settings in which the learner’s input history is generated online through interaction: its actions affect which observations enter context, rather than merely processing a dataset fixed in advance. This includes adaptive data collection, where decisions determine which labels, measurements, rewards, or state transitions arrive next. In active learning, previously observed labels guide the choice of subsequent queries to improve downstream predictions ( Settles, 2009 ) ; bandits reveal selected-arm rewards ( Auer et al., 2002a ; Li et al., 2010 ; Russo et al., 2018 ; Russo et al., 2026 ) ; and online RL also controls persistent state and long-horizon return ( Sutton and Barto, 2018 ; Zanette and Brunskill, 2018 ) . We instantiate BALD for active learning; Thompson sampling, UCB, LinUCB, and EXP3 for bandits; and Q-learning, SARSA, actor-critic, and learned-model planning for online RL, alongside VOI and KG for adaptive query selection ( Frazier et al., 2008 ; Auer et al., 2002b ; Watkins and Dayan, 1992 ; Azar et al., 2017 ) . Bayesian updating, optimism, and planning recur across these settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们关注的学习设定是：学习者的输入历史通过交互在线生成，即其动作会影响哪些观测进入上下文，而不仅仅是处理一个预先固定的数据集。 这包括自适应数据收集，其中决策决定接下来会得到哪些标签、测量值、奖励或状态转移。 在主动学习中，先前观测到的标签用于指导后续查询的选择以改进下游预测（Settles, 2009）；老虎机中仅揭示被选择臂的奖励（Auer et al., 2002a; Li et al., 2010; Russo et al., 2018; Russo et al., 2026）；而在线强化学习还要控制持久状态和长期回报（Sutton and Barto, 2018; Zanette and Brunskill, 2018）。 我们为主动学习实现了 BALD；为老虎机实现了 Thompson 采样、UCB、LinUCB 和 EXP3；为在线强化学习实现了 Q-learning、SARSA、actor-critic 以及基于学习模型的规划，并同时为自适应查询选择实现了 VOI 和 KG（Frazier et al., 2008; Auer et al., 2002b; Watkins and Dayan, 1992; Azar et al., 2017）。 贝叶斯更新、乐观原则和规划在这些设定中反复出现。

paragraphs.en: Universal approximation and recurrent-depth Transformers establish broad expressivity ( Yun et al., 2020 ; Dehghani et al., 2019 ) . Our construction exposes a sufficient-state wavefront, shares parameters across turns, and converts per-action approximation into an autonomous return bound.
paragraphs.zh: 通用逼近与循环深度Transformer确立了广泛的表达能力 ( Yun et al., 2020 ; Dehghani et al., 2019 ) 。 我们的结构暴露了一个充分状态的波前，在各轮之间共享参数，并将每个动作的逼近转化为一个自主的返回界。

paragraphs.en: Process supervision scores intermediate steps, but shaping can change the optimal policy unless action-value ordering is preserved ( Lightman et al., 2023 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Ng et al., 1999 ) . We use potential-based shaping to construct an outcome-preserving process-reward control.
paragraphs.zh: 过程监督会对中间步骤进行评分，但塑形可能会改变最优策略，除非动作价值的排序得到保留（Lightman et al., 2023；Cui et al., 2025；Cheng et al., 2025；Ng et al., 1999）。 我们使用基于势函数的塑形方法来构建一种保持结果的过程奖励控制。

paragraphs.en: Consider an LLM agent asked to solve a coding task. It searches for documentation, executes code, and uses the returned pages or errors to decide what to try next. Each action changes its future evidence. We separate this process into the interaction that generates the transcript and the learner computation that updates evidence and selects actions.

paragraphs.en: This factorization separates how evidence is incorporated from how actions are selected. Consider three representative and widely studied settings of learning problems: active learning selects queries and receives labels to improve downstream predictions; bandits select an arm and reveal its outcome for cumulative reward or regret; and online RL controls both immediate feedback and future states for long-horizon return or regret. They are all included in this framework and distinguished by how actions shape future context. At the interface level, any finite-horizon policy can be expressed in this recursive form by taking s t = h t − 1 s_{t}=h_{t-1} . Importantly, the feedback need not itself be the task reward, separating the records used for in-context adaptation from the task objective. Appendix A gives instantiations.

paragraphs.en: Each field occupies one vector token. The 𝚂𝚄𝙼 \mathtt{SUM} token provides workspace for the learner state; the final 𝙰𝙲𝚃 \mathtt{ACT} token emits the next action. paragraphs.en: Our experiments examine learned execution and objective-dependent decisions. Section 6.1 introduces an exactly diagnosable environment and task; Section 6.2 tests learned compilation from oracle algorithm supervision, to support Theorem 4.1 ; Section 6.3 diagnoses behavior under outcome and process objectives and how it changes under objective interventions, supporting Proposition 5.1 ; Section 6.4 confirms these results using a pretrained LLM with natural-language tools. Unless noted otherwise, metrics are averaged within each seed and reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across five independently trained seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验考察了学习到的执行以及依赖于目标的决策。 第 6.1 节介绍一个可精确诊断的环境与任务；第 6.2 节在 oracle 算法监督下测试学习到的编译，以支持定理 4.1；第 6.3 节诊断在结果目标与过程目标下的智能体行为，以及该行为在目标干预下如何变化，以支持命题 5.1；第 6.4 节使用配备自然语言工具的预训练 LLM 验证这些结果。 除非另有说明，各项指标先在每个种子内部取平均，再在五个独立训练的种子上以均值 ± \pm 标准差的形式报告。

paragraphs.en: Multi-round Bayesian Tool Selection (BTS) models sequential tool use while keeping its optimal policy exactly computable. Each task asks the agent to predict a hidden target Z ∈ [ K ] Z\in[K] using tools e ∈ [ E ] e\in[E] with likelihoods L e ​ ( y ∣ z ) = Pr ⁡ ( Y = y ∣ Z = z , tool ​ e ) L_{e}(y\mid z)=\Pr(Y=y\mid Z=z,\text{tool }e) , costs c e c_{e} , discount δ \delta , and a query budget. A tool-call action e e returns an observation Y ∼ L e ( ⋅ ∣ Z ) Y\sim L_{e}(\cdot\mid Z) , which is appended to the next prompt; an answer action g ∈ [ K ] g\in[K] terminates the episode with reward δ C 𝟏 { g = Z } \delta^{C}\mathbf{1}\{g=Z\} , where C C is the total call cost. Tools are legal only while calls remain and their costs fit the budget; answers are always legal. The initial prompt contains all task-specific parameters, and is followed by the action-evidence transcript.
paragraphs.zh: 多轮贝叶斯工具选择（BTS）模型对序贯工具使用建模，同时保持其最优策略可被精确计算。 每个任务要求智能体使用工具 e ∈ [ K ] 中的 e∈[E] 来预测隐藏目标 Z∈[K]，这些工具具有似然 L_e(y∣z)=Pr(Y=y∣Z=z, tool e)、成本 c_e、折扣因子 δ 以及查询预算。 工具调用动作 e 返回一个观测 Y∼L_e(⋅∣Z)，该观测会被附加到下一个提示中；回答动作 g∈[K] 以奖励 δ^C𝟏{g=Z} 终止回合，其中 C 是总调用成本。 只有在剩余调用次数且其成本符合预算的情况下工具才是合法的；回答动作总是合法。 初始提示包含所有任务特定参数，其后是动作-证据的对话记录。

paragraphs.en: Bayes dynamic programming (Bayes DP) computes an optimal policy for this task. At history h t − 1 h_{t-1} , Bayes DP makes decisions from a sufficient state, consisting of the posterior b t ​ ( z ) = Pr ⁡ ( Z = z ∣ h t − 1 ) b_{t}(z)=\Pr(Z=z\mid h_{t-1}) , remaining call horizon, and remaining budget. It compares immediate answers with the discounted value of future adaptive queries and is exactly outcome-optimal in this finite known environment. Appendix G gives details of this optimal policy.
paragraphs.zh: 贝叶斯动态规划（Bayes DP）为该任务计算最优策略。 在历史 h t − 1 h_{t-1} 处，贝叶斯 DP 基于一个充分状态进行决策，该状态由后验 b t ​ ( z ) = Pr ⁡ ( Z = z ∣ h t − 1 ) b_{t}(z)=\Pr(Z=z\mid h_{t-1})、剩余调用时限和剩余预算组成。 它将即时答案与未来自适应查询的折扣价值进行比较，并且在这一有限已知环境中恰好是结果最优的。 附录 G 给出了该最优策略的细节。

paragraphs.en: Priors, likelihood matrices, labels, costs, discounts, budgets, and query horizons are randomized across episodes, preventing a fixed tool-calling script from matching the task-specific oracle. We evaluate autonomous return on fresh tasks and exact action probabilities on frozen diagnostic histories. Longer-horizon results control for budget feasibility and realized interaction length; Appendix G gives the complete task distribution and protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 先验、似然矩阵、标签、成本、折扣、预算和查询时间范围在各回合之间随机化，防止固定的工具调用脚本匹配到任务特定的最优策略。 我们在全新任务上评估自主回报，并在冻结的诊断历史记录上评估精确的动作概率。 长时间范围的结果控制了预算可行性和实际交互长度；附录 G 给出完整的任务分布和协议。

paragraphs.en: The construction establishes the existence of Transformer parameters that execute interactive recursions. We now test whether supervised training can recover such behavior. We select representative algorithms whose states, updates, and policies can all be computed exactly, allowing us to check each part of the learned recursion. We train a Transformer by supervised distillation from three such algorithms: Bayes DP for active learning, Beta-Bernoulli UCB for bandits, and tabular Q-learning for online RL. Within the same interface, these algorithms require Bayesian updating with planning, count-sum confidence statistics, and bootstrapped value updates, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 该构造证明了存在能够执行交互式递归的 Transformer 参数。 我们现在检验监督训练能否恢复这种行为。 我们选择那些状态、更新和策略都可以精确计算的代表性算法，从而能够检查所学递归的每个部分。 我们通过从三种此类算法进行监督蒸馏来训练 Transformer：用于主动学习的贝叶斯 DP、用于老虎机问题的 Beta-Bernoulli UCB，以及用于在线强化学习的表格型 Q 学习。 在同一接口下，这些算法分别需要结合规划的贝叶斯更新、计数求和的置信度统计，以及自举的价值更新。

Appendix G.4 gives full baselines, training details, and metric definitions.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows that the distilled models closely match all three supplied recursions. Distillation substantially reduces every metric relative to the corresponding random Transformer baseline. Thus optimization can reach qualitatively different realizations permitted by Theorem 4.1 . Bayes DP and UCB degrade less than Q-learning on their respective longer-horizon evaluations, consistent with the additive-state distinction in Appendix E , while the length extrapolation remains empirical.

We next remove oracle action and state targets and train only from rewards, as in RL post-training of language model agents. The central question is how training objectives shape candidate-relative decisions. In particular, we test whether learned behavior tracks changes in the training objective under controlled interventions. We consider four supervision conditions. Outcome reward targets terminal BTS return, for which Bayes DP is optimal; one-step process reward scores immediate local progress; outcome-preserving process reward adds a potential-based shaping term with a fixed bounded perturbation; and Bayes DP-score distillation provides a supervised reference using a softmax over unregularized Bayes DP action values.

paragraphs.en: A verifier scores immediate information gain or apparent progress without computing globally optimal continuation values. Its three parameters ( α , τ v , γ ) (\alpha,\tau_{v},\gamma) control the local score and credit assignment. A call is rewarded when its realized gain in answerability and distributional certainty offsets its cost. The confidence weight α \alpha trades top-answer probability against normalized certainty, τ v \tau_{v} controls how strongly each observation updates the verifier belief, and the credit discount γ \gamma controls how much later verifier progress is assigned to the current action. The primary setting uses ( α , τ v , γ ) = ( .75 , .75 , 0 ) (\alpha,\tau_{v},\gamma)=(.75,.75,0) , and we refer to its γ = 0 \gamma=0 objective as the one-step process reward. Following Proposition 5.1 , the outcome-preserving process reward uses a perturbed potential-shaped dense signal while preserving the outcome-optimal policy set.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器对即时信息增益或表面进展打分，而不计算全局最优的后续行动价值。 它的三个参数 (\alpha,\tau_{v},\gamma) 控制局部评分与信用分配。 当某次调用在可回答性与分布确定性上的实际增益抵消其成本时，该调用会获得奖励。 置信权重 \alpha 在最高答案概率与归一化确定性之间进行权衡，\tau_{v} 控制每次观测对验证器信念的更新强度，而信用折扣 \gamma 控制后续验证器进展有多少被归因于当前动作。 主设置采用 (\alpha,\tau_{v},\gamma)=(.75,.75,0)，我们将其 \gamma=0 的目标称为单步过程奖励。 依据命题 5.1，保结果的过程奖励在保持结果最优策略集的同时，使用一个扰动的势形塑密集信号。

paragraphs.en: To describe the learned policy with ( 7 ), here we consider four candidates sharing the Bayesian update but using different decision rules: Bayes DP, one-step knowledge gradient (KG), one-step entropy reduction, and an open-loop oracle. These candidates distinguish outcome-optimal planning, one-step value of information, a surrogate information objective, and feedback-insensitive acquisition. Appendix G gives the formal definitions of the rewards and candidate policies, the diagnostic histories, and the complete training protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 为了用式 ( 7 ) 描述学到的策略，我们在此考虑四个候选方案，它们共享贝叶斯更新，但使用不同的决策规则：贝叶斯动态规划（Bayes DP）、单步知识梯度（KG）、单步熵减，以及开环先知。 这些候选方案分别对应结果最优规划、单步信息价值、替代性信息目标，以及对反馈不敏感的采集策略。 附录 G 给出了奖励与候选策略的形式化定义、诊断性历史以及完整的训练协议。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows that outcome reward training produces behavior closest to Bayes DP, whereas one-step process reward training produces behavior closest to KG. The latter is consistent with the one-step objective violating the ordering condition in Proposition 5.1 . The outcome-preserving process reward instead remains Bayes DP-like. The bounded perturbation changes individual step rewards, but telescoping leaves the ordering of cumulative action values unchanged. This provides an empirical test of the proposition’s ordering criterion without requiring the process and outcome rewards to be numerically equal. Appendix Table 8 reports the full candidate comparison. We also perform a 12-cell sweep over ( α , τ v ) (\alpha,\tau_{v}) (Appendix G.6 ). The primary ( .75 , .75 ) (.75,.75) result is not an isolated parameter setting: the nearest candidate changes with the verifier reward specification, while the primary KG-like behavior persists across a neighborhood of tested settings. All tested one-step reward settings with γ = 0 \gamma=0 exhibit ordering violations on the diagnostic set and are closest to candidates other than Bayes DP.

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 tests Proposition 5.1 ’s ordering criterion empirically. Panel (a) reports the fractions of diagnostic histories satisfying or violating 𝒜 S , t ∗ ​ ( h ) ⊆ 𝒜 out , t ∗ ​ ( h ) \mathcal{A}_{S,t}^{*}(h)\subseteq\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{out},t}^{*}(h) , and panel (b) reports the learned policies’ top-action agreement with Bayes DP and KG. paragraphs.en: The symbolic experiments show that learned decisions change with the training objective. We now test whether these differences persist when a pretrained language model receives the same task information through natural-language descriptions. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) on BTS with outcome reward, one-step process reward, and Bayes DP-score distillation, then evaluate training templates, unseen paraphrases, and a shuffled-description control. paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that these behavioral differences persist with language inputs and unseen paraphrases. paragraphs.en: We formalize Agentic ICL as interactive adaptation in which a fixed-parameter Transformer shapes its future evidence through actions, without requiring observations to reveal rewards. Our construction realizes regular finite-horizon recursions with a bound on autonomous return loss, and distillation demonstrates learned execution. Reward experiments link decision differences to outcome-optimal action ordering: a perturbed process reward that preserves this ordering retains behavior close to outcome training, while objective interventions shift learned decisions as alignment changes. The outcome/process decision contrast also persists across textual paraphrases in a pretrained language model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体式 ICL 形式化为一种交互式适应过程：一个固定参数的 Transformer 通过行动塑造其未来的证据，而不要求观测揭示奖励。 我们的构造实现了正则有限期递归，并给出自主回报损失的界，同时蒸馏实验展示了习得的执行能力。 奖励实验将决策差异与结果最优的行动排序联系起来：一个保持该排序的扰动过程奖励会使行为接近结果训练的行为，而目标干预则会随着对齐的变化改变习得的决策。 结果/过程决策对比在一个预训练语言模型中也能在文本改写后保持。

paragraphs.en: The theory establishes expressivity under regularity assumptions without guaranteeing optimization convergence. Behavioral comparisons are candidate-relative, and probes do not identify a unique internal algorithm. Experiments use small structured tasks, hand-specified verifiers, and a potential-based control whose perturbation preserves optimal actions exactly. These results do not establish robustness to arbitrary process-reward errors or learned verifiers. Language-model tests supply observation models and constrain actions, leaving generalization to open-ended agents with unknown tool semantics, longer interactions, and context compression unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 该理论在正则性假设下建立了表达能力，但不保证优化收敛。 行为比较是相对于候选而言的，探针无法识别唯一的内部算法。 实验使用小型结构化任务、手工指定的验证器，以及一种基于势的控制，其扰动恰好保持最优动作不变。 这些结果并未建立对任意过程奖励错误或学习式验证器的鲁棒性。 语言模型测试提供了观测模型并约束动作，尚未解决在工具语义未知的开放式智能体、更长交互和上下文压缩情形下的泛化问题。

It uses residual attention-ReLU blocks without layer normalization and treats empirical-model states as pre-normalized. The result concerns representability of a fixed-width learner core; it does not establish training convergence or lossless text encoding. We now give the construction for one vector token per encoded field, using standard causal softmax attention and position-wise ReLU networks. The proof follows explicit-coordinate constructions for static learner functions ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and exact RL updates ( Liang and Lai, 2026 ) ; here, one shared block propagates a general recursive state through a prompt generated by agent-environment interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 该构造为学习器状态及其反馈条件下的更新识别出剩余坐标。 它使用不含层归一化的残差注意力-ReLU 块，并将经验模型状态视为已预先归一化。 该结果涉及固定宽度学习器核心的可表示性；它并未确立训练收敛性或无损文本编码。 我们现在给出每个编码字段对应一个向量词元的构造，使用标准的因果 softmax 注意力和逐位置 ReLU 网络。 该证明遵循针对静态学习器函数（Wu et al., 2025）和精确 RL 更新（Liang and Lai, 2026）的显式坐标构造；在此，一个共享块通过由智能体-环境交互生成的提示传播一个一般性递归状态。

paragraphs.en: The following proposition summarizes the resulting constructive depth upper bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 以下命题总结了由此得到的构造性深度上界。

paragraphs.en: Under the conditions of Theorem 4.1 , every regular horizon- H H recursion admits uniform action-kernel approximation using H H applications of one shared update block and one readout block. Under the additional regularity conditions stated below, the state and all policies of any additive-sufficient recursion can, for every fixed maximum horizon and ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 , be uniformly ϵ \epsilon -approximated with at most three attention-feed-forward blocks. Thus the generic construction has O ⁡ ( H ) O(H) block depth, whereas the additive construction has O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) block depth. Conditionally independent Bayesian updating and UCB count-sum updates are additive-sufficient instances.
paragraphs.zh: 在定理 4.1 的条件下，每个正则的 H H 步时域递归都能通过将一个共享的更新块和一个读出块应用 H H 次来实现一致的动作核逼近。 在下文所述的附加正则性条件下，任何加性充分递归的状态与所有策略，对每个固定的最大时域和 ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0，都能用至多三个注意力-前馈块进行一致的 ϵ \epsilon 逼近。 因此，通用构造具有 O ⁡ ( H ) O(H) 的块深度，而加性构造具有 O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) 的块深度。 条件独立的贝叶斯更新和 UCB 计数和更新都是加性充分的实例。

paragraphs.en: We sample each complete task before its trajectory begins. The default family has K = 4 K=4 hypotheses, E = 6 E=6 tools, and three outcomes per tool. Each hypothesis combines a binary group with a within-group bit. The tool library contains a noisy group diagnostic, two group-specific bit specialists, weaker group and bit shortcuts, and one random distractor. Tool accuracies are perturbed independently across tasks, and every categorical probability is at least 0.02 0.02 , and hypothesis, tool, and per-tool outcome labels are randomly permuted. The useful hierarchy therefore persists without admitting a fixed token-level routing codebook. The prior is a perturbed near-uniform Dirichlet draw.

paragraphs.en: We construct the diagnostic sets from task and oracle quantities before evaluating the models, then hold the histories and evaluation weights fixed. On 200,000 independently generated BTS tasks, a proposal mixture of the original four candidates and a random legal policy generates reachable prefixes. For each history, we compute the exact policies, all pairwise TVs, posterior entropy, and remaining resources. After requiring a maximum pairwise TV of at least 0.10 0.10 , a deterministic round-robin procedure selects D D , a set of 4,096 histories balanced across (i) the maximally separated candidate pair, (ii) stopping versus acquisition decisions, and (iii) horizon and budget. The expanded evaluation adds the two-step candidate on D D .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在评估模型之前，先从任务量和神谕量构建诊断集，然后固定历史记录和评估权重。 在 200,000 个独立生成的 BTS 任务上，由原始四个候选与一个随机合法策略组成的提议混合分布生成可到达的前缀。 对每条历史，我们计算精确策略、所有两两总变差（TV）、后验熵以及剩余资源。 在要求两两总变差的最大值至少为 0.10 0.10 之后，一个确定性的轮询程序选出 D D，这是一个在以下三个方面均衡的 4,096 条历史集合：(i) 间隔最大的候选对，(ii) 停止决策与获取决策，(iii) 视界与预算。 扩展的评估在 D D 上加入两步候选。

paragraphs.en: Resource interventions change a public budget or horizon field while fixing the prior, likelihoods, costs, discount, evidence records, transcript length, and current legal-action mask (Table 10 ). We select histories where future resource opportunities change Bayes continuation values; current action availability alone therefore cannot explain the response. The exact immediate verifier optimum is unchanged because neither its evidence aggregate nor its legal action scores change.
paragraphs.zh: 资源干预在固定先验、似然、成本、折扣、证据记录、转录长度和当前合法动作掩码的情况下，改变公共预算或视界字段（表 10）。 我们选取未来资源机会会改变贝叶斯延续值的历史；因此，仅凭当前动作的可用性无法解释这种响应。 精确的即时验证器最优值保持不变，因为其证据聚合值和合法动作得分均未改变。

paragraphs.en: The primary symbolic conditions in Table 12 and Figure 3 , including the outcome-preserving process-reward control, use a pre-layer-normalized causal Transformer with six layers, residual width 256, eight attention heads, feed-forward width 1,024, GELU activations, and zero dropout. paragraphs.en: Distillation uses AdamW with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , zero weight decay, batch size 256, and gradient-norm clipping at 1. The reward conditions share the same initialization distribution and clipped PPO implementation. Each of 100,000 updates collects multiple fresh on-policy episodes and performs four full-batch PPO epochs using learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , clip ratio 0.2, value-loss coefficient 0.5, and gradient-norm clipping at 1. The entropy coefficient decreases linearly from 0.01 0.01 to zero during the first 30 % 30\% of updates and remains zero for the final 70 % 70\% . Outcome reward and the outcome-preserving control use GAE with γ PPO = 1 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=1 and λ = 1 \lambda=1 . On complete finite-horizon episodes, this reduces to the Monte Carlo advantage A ^ t = G t − V ϕ ​ ( h t − 1 ) \widehat{A}_{t}=G_{t}-V_{\phi}(h_{t-1}) , where G t = ∑ u = t T r u G_{t}=\sum_{u=t}^{T}r_{u} . The primary one-step process reward condition uses γ PPO = 0 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=0 , so every visited decision is trained from its own immediate verifier score, G t = r ~ t 1 ​ V G_{t}=\widetilde{r}_{t}^{\rm 1V} , without credit from later verifier scores. All decision positions still contribute to the PPO loss. Value targets and standardized advantages follow the same implementation, and the optimization budget is unchanged. Five initialization seeds are fixed in advance, all final-budget checkpoints are reported, and no diagnostic history is used for checkpoint selection.

paragraphs.en: We render the same BTS task distribution as a chat transcript for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, including the independently sampled training-time horizons and budgets in Table 3 . The initial user message states the four candidate targets and their prior probabilities, the six tool cards and their conditional outcome probabilities, tool costs, the cost discount, and the initial budget and call horizon. Subsequent user messages append the selected tool, its returned outcome, and the mechanically updated resources. Every probability used by the simulator and the exact oracles is the value printed in the prompt; the sampled target, posterior belief, oracle values, correctness, and trainer reward are never shown. Target, tool, and outcome names are random nonce words, and their order is independently permuted across tasks. We use four training-template families and reserve eight disjoint paraphrase families for evaluation; a family jointly specifies the wording of the task, tool cards, resource records, and returned observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将相同的 BTS 任务分布渲染为 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的聊天记录，其中包括表 3 中独立采样的训练时域与预算。 初始用户消息给出四个候选目标及其先验概率、六个工具卡及其条件结果概率、工具成本、成本折扣，以及初始预算与调用时域。 后续用户消息附加所选工具、其返回结果，以及机械更新的资源。 模拟器与精确 oracle 使用的每个概率都是提示词中打印的值；采样得到的目标、后验信念、oracle 值、正确性与训练奖励从不显示。 目标、工具和结果的名称都是随机 nonce 词，并且它们的顺序在各任务之间独立置换。 我们使用四个训练模板家族，并保留八个不相交的改写家族用于评估；一个家族同时规定了任务、工具卡、资源记录和返回观测的措辞。

paragraphs.en: The model emits no rationale. Ten tokenizer-verified single-token action identifiers represent the four terminal answers and six tool calls, and their assignment is randomly permuted and stated in each initial prompt. At the first assistant-token position we restrict the softmax to the legal identifiers, sample one action during autonomous rollouts, and append the sampled identifier to the transcript. Thus the complete legal-policy is obtained directly from the corresponding next-token logits, without parsing free-form generations. An abbreviated example of the initial user message follows; every actual prompt enumerates all ten action-ID assignments and all six complete tool cards.
paragraphs.zh: 模型不输出任何理由说明。 十个经分词器验证的单token动作标识符代表四个最终答案和六次工具调用，其分配方式被随机打乱，并在每条初始提示中说明。 在第一个assistant token位置，我们将softmax限制在合法标识符上，在自主 rollout 期间采样一个动作，并将采样得到的标识符附加到对话记录中。 因此，完整的合法策略直接由相应的下一token logits 得到，无需解析自由格式的生成内容。 下面是初始用户消息的简短示例；每条实际提示都会列出全部十个动作ID分配以及全部六张完整的工具卡片。

paragraphs.en: All three conditions start from the same pretrained checkpoint and use full-parameter fine-tuning: all Transformer blocks, token embeddings, and the language-model head are updated, with neither adapters nor a frozen backbone. The two policy-optimization conditions attach a scalar value head at assistant decision positions; this head is removed for behavioral evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 三种条件均从同一个预训练检查点出发并采用全参数微调：所有 Transformer 模块、词元嵌入和语言模型头都会被更新，既不使用适配器，也不冻结骨干。 两个策略优化条件在智能体决策位置附加一个标量价值头；该头在行为评估时会被移除。

The one-step process reward condition instead receives the realized local-progress score in ( 45 ) at the primary parameters ( α , τ v ) = ( 0.75 , 0.75 ) (\alpha,\tau_{v})=(0.75,0.75) ; no verifier distribution or reward is added to the prompt. It uses the same clipped-PPO implementation, task streams, and optimization budget, with the one-step credit assignment described below. The Bayes DP-score distillation condition rolls out π B , 0.02 score \pi_{{\rm B},0.02}^{\rm score} and minimizes cross-entropy to its complete masked policy at every assistant decision position. It receives neither outcome nor process rewards and serves as a supervised smooth-reference condition rather than an algorithm-discovery or outcome-optimal condition.

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune in bfloat16 with a maximum context length of 4,096 and zero dropout. Each PPO update collects multiple fresh episodes, followed by four epochs over episode minibatches of size 32. We use AdamW with actor learning rate 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , value-head learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} , weight decay 0.01, a 3% linear warmup followed by cosine decay, PPO clip ratio 0.2, value-loss coefficient 0.5, and gradient-norm clipping at 1. Outcome-reward advantages use GAE with γ PPO = 1 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=1 and λ = 1 \lambda=1 , which reduces to the Monte Carlo return on complete episodes. One-step process reward advantages use γ PPO = 0 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=0 , so the target at each decision is its immediate realized verifier reward. All visited decision positions contribute to the PPO loss, but a later verifier score is not credited to an earlier action. Value targets and advantages are standardized over all decision positions in each rollout batch. The entropy coefficient decreases linearly from 0.01 to zero during the first 30% of updates; no reference-policy KL reward is used.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 bfloat16 进行微调，最大上下文长度为 4,096，dropout 为零。 每次 PPO 更新会收集多个全新的回合（episode），随后对大小为 32 的回合小批量（minibatch）进行四个 epoch 的训练。 我们使用 AdamW，策略网络（actor）学习率为 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} ，价值头（value-head）学习率为 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ，权重衰减为 0.01，先进行 3% 的线性预热再进行余弦衰减，PPO 裁剪比为 0.2，价值损失系数为 0.5，梯度范数裁剪阈值为 1。 结果奖励（outcome-reward）优势使用 GAE，其中 γ PPO = 1 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=1 且 λ = 1 \lambda=1 ，这在完整回合上等价于蒙特卡洛回报。 单步过程奖励优势使用 γ PPO = 0 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=0 ，因此每个决策点的目标就是其即时获得的验证器奖励。 所有经过的决策位置都计入 PPO 损失，但较晚的验证器得分不会归功于较早的动作。 价值目标和优势在每个回合采集批次（rollout batch）内的所有决策位置上进行标准化。 熵系数在更新前 30% 阶段从 0.01 线性递减至零；不使用参考策略的 KL 奖励。

sents.zh: 我们使用 bfloat16 进行微调，最大上下文长度为 4,096，dropout 为零。

sents.en: Each PPO update collects multiple fresh episodes, followed by four epochs over episode minibatches of size 32.
sents.zh: 每次 PPO 更新会收集多个全新的回合（episode），随后对大小为 32 的回合小批量（minibatch）进行四个 epoch 的训练。

sents.en: We use AdamW with actor learning rate 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , value-head learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} , weight decay 0.01, a 3% linear warmup followed by cosine decay, PPO clip ratio 0.2, value-loss coefficient 0.5, and gradient-norm clipping at 1.

sents.en: Outcome-reward advantages use GAE with γ PPO = 1 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=1 and λ = 1 \lambda=1 , which reduces to the Monte Carlo return on complete episodes.
sents.zh: 结果奖励（outcome-reward）优势使用 GAE，其中 γ PPO = 1 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=1 且 λ = 1 \lambda=1 ，这在完整回合上等价于蒙特卡洛回报。

sents.en: One-step process reward advantages use γ PPO = 0 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=0 , so the target at each decision is its immediate realized verifier reward.
sents.zh: 单步过程奖励优势使用 γ PPO = 0 \gamma_{\rm PPO}=0 ，因此每个决策点的目标就是其即时获得的验证器奖励。

sents.en: All visited decision positions contribute to the PPO loss, but a later verifier score is not credited to an earlier action.
sents.zh: 所有经过的决策位置都计入 PPO 损失，但较晚的验证器得分不会归功于较早的动作。

sents.en: Value targets and advantages are standardized over all decision positions in each rollout batch.

sents.en: The entropy coefficient decreases linearly from 0.01 to zero during the first 30% of updates; no reference-policy KL reward is used.

paragraphs.en: Distillation uses the same pretrained initialization, context length, full-parameter update, batch size of 128 fresh oracle trajectories, and 4,000-update budget. It uses AdamW with learning rate 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.01, the same warmup and cosine schedule, and gradient-norm clipping at 1. Five seeds are fixed before training. Every result uses the final-budget checkpoint; neither candidate distances nor paraphrase evaluations are used for hyperparameter choice or checkpoint selection.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏使用相同的预训练初始化、上下文长度、全参数更新、128 条新产生的 oracle 轨迹的批量大小以及 4,000 次更新的预算。 它使用 AdamW，学习率为 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5}，权重衰减为 0.01，采用相同的预热与余弦调度，并将梯度范数裁剪为 1。 五个随机种子在训练前已固定。 所有结果均使用最终预算的检查点；候选距离与释义评估都不用于超参数选择或检查点选择。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each trained condition on fresh BTS tasks rendered with (i) the training-template families, (ii) each of the eight held-out paraphrase families, and (iii) a description-kernel mismatch control. In the mismatch control, tool-card bodies are permuted among action identifiers while the simulator kernels associated with those identifiers remain fixed. We pair the same canonical tasks and histories across textual renderings and denote the text evaluation histories by D text D_{\rm text} . We report text and symbolic results separately, with candidate-distance profiles evaluated at the fixed temperature τ = 0.02 \tau=0.02 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在全新 BTS 任务上评估每个训练后的条件，这些任务分别以以下方式呈现：(i) 训练模板族，(ii) 八个留出改述族中的每一个，以及 (iii) 描述-内核失配对照。 在失配对照中，工具卡正文在动作标识符之间进行置换，而与这些标识符相关联的模拟器内核保持不变。 我们在不同文本呈现之间配对相同的规范任务与历史，并将文本评估历史记为 D text D_{\rm text} 。 我们分别报告文本与符号结果，候选距离剖面在固定温度 τ = 0.02 \tau=0.02 下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Together with Table 24 , the expanded means remain closest to Bayes for outcome training and distillation, and to KG for the verifier, on both normal templates and paraphrases. For distilled models on paraphrases, Bayes and two-step distances are 0.104 0.104 and 0.123 0.123 ; the mean gap is 0.019 0.019 , but these aggregate results do not establish seedwise stability. In the mismatch control, distances to every candidate are large, so a small relative advantage is not interpreted as reliable algorithm recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 结合表24来看，扩展后的均值方法在结果训练与蒸馏上仍最接近贝叶斯，在校验器上最接近KG，在正常模板和改写模板上均如此。 对于改写模板上的蒸馏模型，贝叶斯与两步法的距离分别为0.104 0.104和0.123 0.123，均值差距为0.019 0.019，但这些汇总结果并不能证明逐种子层面的稳定性。 在失配对照中，与所有候选对象的距离都很大，因此微小的相对优势不会被解读为可靠的算法恢复。
